articles.summary: Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (“IRT”) (NYSE: IRT) announces the release date and conference call details related to its second quarter 2026 financial results. Details: Results Release Date: Monday, August 3, 2026, after the market closes Conference Call Date and Time: Tuesday, August 4, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time Telephone Number (within the U.S.): (833) 461-5787 Conference ID (Passcode): 379217423 The live conference call can also be accessed from the “Investors” section of IRT’s website, https://investors.irtliving.com . Replay Information: Shortly after the live conference call concludes, a webcast replay will be available on the “Investors” section of IRT’s website, https://investors.irtliving.com . About IRT: Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), an SP 400 MidCap Company, is a real estate investment trust (“REIT”) that owns and operates multifamily communities, across non-gateway U.S. markets.
